uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-6593-8320.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Yoshimaru.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3693-6593-8320.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2390-3966-6825.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-6825.description:
Gain life.
MJ triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1832-2034-6634.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-6634.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2783-2841-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-5131-6289-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6289-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-7577-7875.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-7577-7875.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Emeritus of Truce.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Truce, which enters prepared.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares.
Repeat.

2793-3743-5089-7435-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-7435-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

341-1621-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

206-527-542.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
206-527-542.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1753-1765-2440-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1753-1765-2440-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7325.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Thermopod enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thermopod.
Repeat.
5231-6972-7325.notes: You can use any other nontoken creature you control instead of Thermopod so long as it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.

2366-4068-5702-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4068-5702-7288.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2366-4068-5702-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

643-2366-4050-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-2366-4050-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-4050-5997-7055.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2534-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-1532-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-5231.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

620-3532-5078-6747.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
You control an additional artifact.
620-3532-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

3532-3761-5078-6747.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

1818-2034-5010-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2034-5010-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

4200-4590-6867.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that can attack this turn.
4200-4590-6867.description:
Declare two creatures as attackers, ensuring to attack two different opponents. Commander Liara Portyr triggers, causing spells you cast from exile this turn to cost {2} less to cast.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa
Repeat from step 3.

293-5220-5716-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1
Repeat.

2421-3168-4050-6711.manaNeeded: {R}{R} if Sabin is in your graveyard or {2}{R} plus commander tax if applicable otherwise
2421-3168-4050-6711.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional card in hand.
2421-3168-4050-6711.description:
If Sabin is in your graveyard, cast it for its blitz cost by paying {R}{R} and discarding a card. Otherwise, cast Sabin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sabin and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Choose not to return Sabin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sabin dies, if it was cast using its blitz ability, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

813-2103-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Essence Flux.
813-2103-4598.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

406-1339-6466.easyPrerequisites: Tandem Lookout paired with Shocking Sharpshooter.
406-1339-6466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-6466.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Shocking Sharpshooter, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Shocking Sharpshooter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1-1786-5436-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

2653-4772-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2653-4772-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2653-4772-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2440-4183-4730-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy
2440-4183-4730-4758.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

67-2525-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double leaves the battlefield, it triggers its Reveillark ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2050-3525-5386.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Blighted Burgeoning attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-5386.notablePrerequisites: Arbor Elf does not have summoning sickness.
2050-3525-5386.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
The triggered ability from the Aura triggers, adding an additional {U}.
Activate the Aura attached to Arbor Elf by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may add other colors in step 3.

1170-3139-4761.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
1170-3139-4761.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand and drawing a card.
Repeat.

891-2386-2579-5256.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-2579-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Boonweaver Giant's power.
Repeat.

728-3490-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-3490-4871.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

638-2093-3584.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
638-2093-3584.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Lapse of Certainty by paying {2}{W}, targeting that spell.
Thousand-Year Storm and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, creating at least one copy of Lapse of Certainty, with each copy targeting the original Lapse of Certainty.
Resolve the first copy of Lapse of Certainty, countering the original Lapse of Certainty and putting it on top of your library.
All remaining Lapse of Certainty copies fizzle due to no longer having a legal target.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Lapse of Certainty without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

1447-2034-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two nontoken Humans.
1447-2034-4499.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing all nontoken Humans, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Angel of Glory's Rise.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, exiling all Zombies and returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1824-4191.easyPrerequisites: You haven't completed and are not currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
1824-4191.description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Acererak the Archlich enters, it triggers both of its abilities.
Resolve one Acererak ability, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the other Acererak ability, venturing into a dungeon that is not Tomb of Annihilation.
Repeat.

3169-3374-4050-4053.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving target white creature you control persist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature's persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

39-2302-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Alabaster Dragon.
Alabaster Dragon and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Alabaster Dragon trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Alabaster Dragon, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Alabaster Dragon's power.
Repeat.

65-717-1094-2628-2993.description:
Activate Slippery Karst's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Slippery Karst, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Slippery Karst trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Stoic Builder.
Stoic Builder enters the battlefield, returning Slippery Karst from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

802-914-1235-2649.manaNeeded: {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, plus commander tax if applicable, plus one additional red, white, or blue mana if opponents control exactly three artifacts and/or enchantments
802-914-1235-2649.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
802-914-1235-2649.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Dockside Extortionist and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature.
The token Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}{R}.
Resolve a second trigger from step 8, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 8, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 8 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 7, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Dockside Extortionist mutated creature token.
